description: ARCHIVED Natural Gas – Imports and Exports is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Canada Energy Regulator | La Régie de l’énergie du Canada. The Canada Energy Regulator (CER) regulates the export of natural gas. Orders or licenses are required to export natural gas, including liquefied natural gas, from Canada. Holders of these authorizations report monthly on their activities to CER. Import and export activities are available by port from 1985 to August 2024. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Canada Energy Regulator | La Régie de l’énergie du Canada. Its tags are natural gas, imports, exports, CER, NEB. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2024-11-08 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
